name: base
title: Rime base: tokens and base styles
description: Design tokens (Default and Flat presets, light and dark modes), base element rules, the shadcn variable bridge and the shared internals. Install first.
docs: Import the styles in app/globals.css, before anything else: @import "./styles/tokens.css"; @import "./styles/base.css"; @import "./styles/shadcn-bridge.css"; Add your theme.css (from Rime Studio) after them. Requires the "@/*": ["./*"] path alias and no src/ directory.
